data.title: Anagram Values: The Right Value
data.statement:
Rules

Each letter has a fixed point value (standard Scrabble table: A=1, B=3, C=3, D=2, E=1, F=4, G=2, H=4, I=1, J=8, K=5, L=1, M=3, N=1, O=1, P=3, Q=10, R=1, S=1, T=1, U=1, V=4, W=4, X=8, Y=4, Z=10).
For each scrambled group, check if its letters (as a multiset) match any dictionary word. If not, discard it.
Among the groups that do match a dictionary word, compute that word's total value (sum of letter values).
If mode is "high", output the valid word with the highest total value. If "low", output the one with the lowest.
Tie-break: alphabetically first.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Rules

Each letter has a fixed point value (standard Scrabble table: A=1, B=3, C=3, D=2, E=1, F=4, G=2, H=4, I=1, J=8, K=5, L=1, M=3, N=1, O=1, P=3, Q=10, R=1, S=1, T=1, U=1, V=4, W=4, X=8, Y=4, Z=10).
For each scrambled group, check if its letters (as a multiset) match any dictionary word. If not, discard it.
Among the groups that do match a dictionary word, compute that word's total value (sum of letter values).
If mode is "high", output the valid word with the highest total value. If "low", output the one with the lowest.
Tie-break: alphabetically first.
Input
Line 1: mode (high or low)
Line 2: N (number of scrambled groups)
Next N lines: scrambled letter groups
Line N+3: D (dictionary size)
Next D lines: valid dictionary words
Output
Line 1: The word with lowest value if mode is low else the word with highest value.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 20 (number of scrambled groups)
1 ≤ D ≤ 20 (dictionary size)
1 ≤ length of each word ≤ 12
mode = high or low
All words use only lowercase letters a-z
At least one scrambled group is guaranteed to match a dictionary word
Example
Input
high
5
tac
xbb
pza
nlio
ofx
5
cat
dog
zap
lion
fox
Output
zap
